notes: «باسناده يرفعه إلى» is a gap the text marks (rule 8): an unnamed link at that point, never filled from memory
The two «محمد بن الحسن» are different men (Ibn al-Walid's shaykh and al-Saffar), as the text writes them (rule 7)
Amir al-Mu'minin is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he is a narrator; «رضي الله عنه» is stripped
